competitionModes.name: Vault Score Attack
competitionModes.objective: Earn the highest verified score on the same seeded vault configuration.

competitionModes.name: Talon Time Trial
competitionModes.objective: Clear the required vault sequence in the lowest verified time.

competitionModes.name: Head-to-Head Vault
competitionModes.objective: Two players compete on identical seeded conditions; best validated result advances.

competitionModes.name: Falcon Team Relay
competitionModes.objective: Teams complete assigned vault legs; combined verified score/time determines ranking.

principles: server validates score, stage, duration and tournament seed
client cannot set verified status, winner, rank or prize
flag impossible movement, impossible score rates, invalid lock cooldowns and modified seed/state
retain match evidence and audit records
flagged runs do not appear on verified leaderboards until reviewed

prizes.default: non-cash digital recognition, trophies, cosmetics and approved rewards
prizes.realMoney: disabled by default; requires jurisdiction-specific contest/sweepstakes/gaming, tax, age, identity and payment compliance review
